EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Agency should have a minimum Total Financial Turnover 5 Crores in the last five years(i.e 2021-22 to 2025-26)Consolidated financial turnover certificate certified by CharteredAccountant shall be submitted, along with compulsory UDIN Id No.

The firm/ agency/ institution should have a minimum of 5 years of experience of undertakinginspection of project works relating to water supply and/ or civil infrastructure and shouldhave monitored at least two projects. For TPIA firm, work done certificates issued by theemployer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent Cadre person shall besubmitted mandatorily

Experience in providing TPIA in Karnataka.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practicesissued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

The Executive Engineer reserves the right to accept/reject any or all tenders withoutassigning any reasons.
